maddeler.e:
نندفع (form VII)
# نَنْدَفِعُ (nandafiʕu) /nan.da.fi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْدَفَعَ (indafaʕa)
# نَنْدَفِعَ (nandafiʕa) /nan.da.fi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَفَعَ (indafaʕa)
# نَنْدَفِعْ (nandafiʕ) /nan.da.fiʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْدَفَعَ (indafaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
